## Native SSPRK2 and common gas midpoint (2026-10-19)

The previous frozen-reconstruction exponential transport retained a local O(h²) reprojection defect and observed first-order global error. This continuation adds an explicit opt-in SSPRK(2,2) integration of the closed native moment RHS and a common four-variable gas midpoint. It keeps the physical GL2 birth chronology, native rates/EOS, and existing default/adaptive/checkpoint paths.

Source and results publication: [339dab4336d1fcfd38106640ee9bf7056dabcfd8](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/commit/339dab4336d1fcfd38106640ee9bf7056dabcfd8). Runtime identity is the source-file SHA256 receipts; this later publication commit is not retroactively labelled the runtime checkout.

### Changes and resulting behavior

- Two true forward-Euler node stages re-prepare the spectrum and use the same averaged photon, reaction, binding, and heat weights. Both actual stages enforce node CFL <= 1; violations return AXBI_SSP_CFL without clipping or automatic subcycling.
- The coupled expansion includes F_g H and Q_M F. Actual Wolfram formal expansion gives both h² residuals zero. Photon realizability is conditional on stage CFL; gas positivity also requires an admissible converged implicit solve.
- Independent raw review found a concrete short-interval clock error in log(a_end/a_begin). The new opt-in path uses log1p((a_end-a_begin)/a_begin) and passes the exact accepted solve dt to its ledger. Against the same binary64 endpoints and native H, the N512 accumulated clock error changed from +112.286124136 s to -4.882812e-7 s. Pre-repair code/results are preserved.

### Actual validation and limits

Rust 1.94.1 sandbox: offline/locked release build, 14 distinct targeted tests, 52 transport diagnostic rows, and 16 distinct coupled settings (6 fixed geometry + 5 seeded source-disabled GL2 + 5 physical source GL2), all exit 0. The same 16 settings ran once before and once after the clock repair; they are not 32 new cases. Prior manufactured76/Python57/original NCP84/projection62 campaigns were reused, not rerun.

Broad-spectrum transport has finest local/global self-difference exponents 2.99749/2.01876. In the specified short physical GL2 source interval, finest exponents are photon N 2.04256, w 2.03401, T 2.02319, and photoheat 2.02858. HeIII endpoint order remains HOLD (finest difference about 2.4e-17). Independent raw reconstruction gives maximum photon-number residual 1.3712e-16/H, photon-energy residual 2.0110e-15 eV/H, and total energy from EOS-reconstructed w 2.9327e-14 eV/H.

These results do not establish general all-channel source-on second order, uniform stiff accuracy, Case B, full EoR, signed Bianchi, or native fourth order. Actual boundary/passive values were zero and native CMB terms negative.

Normal Python restore/run files are published. Fresh restoration, hashes, CLI/prepare-only, and explicit compiler-failure receipts were checked; the wrapper's scientific all mode is left for actual NCP reproduction. This session made no new NCP run: the specified key was absent and the remote execution connector was usage-paused.

### Delivery

Final receipt HEAD: [`fa9615a565a10a770eb1768d8f10cd503b0e1336`](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/commit/fa9615a565a10a770eb1768d8f10cd503b0e1336).

## Earlier execution and diagnostic record

## Native reconstruction-order diagnosis (2026-10-19)

The completed NCP baseline has source-on GL2 temperature self-difference order about 1.06/0.95. This continuation identifies a concrete transport mechanism: each source-free segment reconstructs the spectrum from its two moments and then attenuates that frozen reconstruction. At fixed gas/geometry, the full-map versus two-half-map defect is `h²/4 A L (I − R′ A) L R + O(h³)`. The general projection expansion is established literature; the contribution here is its application to this exact native source path and its native evidence.

Source/results commit: [`806ad09be146486a492f62393e0a2c578330acf5`](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/commit/806ad09be146486a492f62393e0a2c578330acf5).

### What changed and why

- Added a native diagnostic example, analyzer, completed reproduction runner, raw CSV/cell evidence, figures, Korean derivation and independent review under `v14/projection_diagnostic_20261019/`.
- Used actual MD14 initialization, original Verner opacity and physical c, with fixed gas/geometry; 48 pair comparisons plus 14 fixed-medium history rows. These 62 rows are not new cosmological histories.
- Reanalyzed the preserved original CSV with exact finite EOS differences. Photoheating and species absorption allocation carry the leading temperature refinement; original source-off controls have zero photon population.
- Corrected the two original summary JSON global species-event maxima from 0 to `4.84017834763862e-14/H`, preserving the original value and the source of the correction. No original raw trajectory or ledger was changed.
- Refreshed stale NOT_RUN handoffs. Clarified that `ef94f08…` was created after the original run and identifies evidence publication, not an attested runtime checkout.

### Actual validation and interpretation

- Sandbox Rust1.94.1, offline/locked release build with two jobs: exit0. First native run: exit0, 0.094112117s.
- 16-cell local N/U pair-defect slopes: 1.94260/1.95516; fixed-medium global successive-difference slopes: N1.00924, U1.00736, HeI0.99318, heat0.97984. Local slope2 does not imply global order2.
- Delta60 pair relative N/U discrepancy <=`1.65e-16`; tiny native N/U conservation residuals coexist with the broad-spectrum time error.
- One necessary fresh-sibling restoration/runner replay passed all stages and reproduced both CSVs byte for byte (62 summary rows;13,312 cell rows). It is the same scientific matrix, not additional unique cases.
- Separate agent review: `PASS_SCOPED`. Full coupled causal attribution remains unresolved. Four original V14 native outputs, rates, source, EOS, default/adaptive/checkpoint remain unchanged.
- No rerun of the old 84-history campaign,36 tests,57 manufactured Python tests, or76 toy cases. This turn's NCP probe was blocked by a monthly-usage service error; the new diagnostic actually ran in sandbox.

Full source-on second order, uniform stiff accuracy, CaseB, full EoR and signed Bianchi remain HOLD. The next algorithm task is time-centering the closed-moment photon–gas stages while preserving current closure/rates. It is not a compatibility edit delegated to NCP.

[Full Korean research report](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/blob/806ad09be146486a492f62393e0a2c578330acf5/research/lrs_atomic_native_bridge_20261016/v14/projection_diagnostic_20261019/RESEARCH_CONTINUATION_KO.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/blob/806ad09be146486a492f62393e0a2c578330acf5/research/lrs_atomic_native_bridge_20261016/v14/projection_diagnostic_20261019/INDEPENDENT_PROJECTION_REVIEW.md)

Draft PR only; no production merge. Earlier execution-audit commit: `55d267d00e8dd9b04005af5d8551e948251c0777`. Frozen native code anchor: `f6046418d15e2f44418dfbc04ca67999f389a7df`; V13 parent: `7fb18cec3d6d6eebad5fe418ec83b36d82cfff1e`.
